Script:

```js
import { getLogic } from './src/components/Game/logic.ts'
import { hatetris } from './src/components/Game/Game.tsx'
import hatetrisRotationSystem from './src/rotation-systems/hatetris-rotation-system.ts'

const logic = getLogic({
  bar: 4,
  replayTimeout: 0,
  copyTimeout: 0,
  rotationSystem: hatetrisRotationSystem,
  wellDepth: 20,
  wellWidth: 10
})

let state = {
  error: null,
  displayEnemy: false,
  enemy: hatetris,
  customAiCode: '',
  mode: 'REPLAYING',
  wellStateId: -1,
  wellStates: [],
  replay: ['D'],
  replayCopiedTimeoutId: undefined,
  replayTimeoutId: undefined
}

state.wellStates.push(await logic.getFirstWellState(state))
state.wellStateId++

console.log('first piece:', state.wellStates[0].piece)

// apply replay move D (mode REPLAYING)
state = await logic.handleMove(state, 'D')
console.log('after replay: wellStateId', state.wellStateId, 'mode', state.mode, 'piece', state.wellStates[state.wellStateId].piece)

let presses = 0
while (state.mode !== 'GAME_OVER' && presses < 500) {
  state = await logic.handleMove(state, 'D')
  presses++
}
console.log('presses to game over:', presses, 'final mode:', state.mode)
console.log('replay length:', state.replay.length, 'all D:', state.replay.every(m => m === 'D'))
console.log('score:', state.wellStates[state.wellStateId].core.score)
```

import hatetrisRotationSystem from './src/rotation-systems/hatetris-rotation-system.ts'

  replayTimeout: 0,
  copyTimeout: 0,
  rotationSystem: hatetrisRotationSystem,

// Throwaway fact-finding: mirror the test exactly —
// replay 'D', undo, redo, then press D until game over.
import { getLogic } from './src/components/Game/logic.ts'
import { hatetris } from './src/components/Game/Game.tsx'
import hatetrisRotationSystem from './src/rotation-systems/hatetris-rotation-system.ts'

const logic = getLogic({
  bar: 4,
  replayTimeout: 0,
  copyTimeout: 0,
  rotationSystem: hatetrisRotationSystem,
  wellDepth: 20,
  wellWidth: 10
})

let state = {
  error: null,
  displayEnemy: false,
  enemy: hatetris,
  customAiCode: '',
  mode: 'REPLAYING',
  wellStateId: -1,
  wellStates: [],
  replay: ['D'],
  replayCopiedTimeoutId: undefined,
  replayTimeoutId: undefined
}

state.wellStates.push(await logic.getFirstWellState(state))
state.wellStateId++

// replay step
state = await logic.handleMove(state, 'D')
console.log('after replay: mode', state.mode, 'wellStateId', state.wellStateId, 'replay', state.replay)

// undo (wellStateId--), then redo (handleMove(replay[wellStateId]))
state = { ...state, mode: 'PLAYING', wellStateId: state.wellStateId - 1 }
state = await logic.handleMove(state, state.replay[state.wellStateId])
console.log('after undo+redo: mode', state.mode, 'wellStateId', state.wellStateId, 'replay', state.replay)

let presses = 0
while (state.mode !== 'GAME_OVER' && presses < 200) {
  state = await logic.handleMove(state, 'D')
  presses++
}

console.log('presses to game over:', presses)
console.log('replay length:', state.replay.length)
console.log('non-D moves:', state.replay.filter(move => move !== 'D'))
console.log('last 5:', state.replay.slice(-5))
console.log('score:', state.wellStates[state.wellStateId].core.score)
